sources.citation: Greshake et al., Indirect Prompt Injection, arXiv 2023
sources.shows: Instructions placed in retrieved data can compromise LLM-integrated apps.
sources.doesNotShow: AISec 2023 venue not confirmed on page; says nothing about viewers.

sources.shows: Injections need not be human-visible; no known fool-proof prevention.
Invisible Unicode in rules files hid instructions; GitHub added hidden-Unicode warning 2025-05-01; Cursor called it user responsibility.
sources.doesNotShow: Vendor write-up of own finding; vendor positions unconfirmed independently.

sources.citation: Rehberger, Hiding and finding text with Unicode tags, 2024
sources.shows: Tag block chars mostly undrawn but LLM-readable; recommends filtering.

sources.citation: Liu et al., Formalizing and Benchmarking Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses, USENIX Sec 2024
sources.shows: 5 attacks x 10 defenses x 10 models x 7 tasks benchmark.
sources.doesNotShow: Abstract gave no detector verdict; 'detectors unreliable' not established from this source.

sources.citation: Nasr et al., The Attacker Moves Second, arXiv 2025
sources.shows: Adaptive attacks bypassed 12 defenses, >90% success for most.
sources.doesNotShow: Which of the 12 are detectors; not a test of viewer flags.

sources.citation: Boucher & Anderson, Trojan Source, USENIX Sec 2023
sources.shows: Bidi reordering makes displayed code differ from compiled code across 12 languages.
sources.doesNotShow: CVE numbers not on abstract page; not cited.

sources.shows: Overrides to be avoided for security; isolates contain effects.
Skeletons, restriction levels, limited-context ZWJ/ZWNJ.
sources.doesNotShow: Tag characters not mentioned in fetched summary.

sources.citation: Dhamija, Tygar, Hearst, Why Phishing Works, CHI 2006
sources.shows: 22 participants: 23% ignored browser cues, wrong 40% of the time.
sources.doesNotShow: Small sample; browser chrome not document links.

sources.citation: Lin et al., Does domain highlighting help..., CHI 2011
sources.shows: Domain highlighting helped some user types much less.
sources.doesNotShow: Not read; only that highlighting helps somewhat but is not reliable alone.

sources.citation: Lain et al., URL Inspection Tasks, USENIX Sec 2025
sources.shows: 2,673 participants: active inspection tasks cut phishing success.
Punycode shown for mixed-script, whole-script confusable, invisible chars, top-domain skeleton match.
Script-rewritten clipboard; newline auto-executes; escapes act in editors.

sources.citation: Xiong et al., Is Domain Highlighting Actually Helpful in Identifying Phishing Web Pages?, Human Factors 59(4), 2017
sources.shows: Re-tests domain highlighting, noting the earlier formal study confounded it with instructions.

sources.doesNotShow: Only two models; no survey of comment stripping.
